title: Do LLM Agents Execute the Plans They Declare? From Planning-Mode Declaration to Pattern-Specific Execution
abstract: arXiv:2609.38108v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) enable agents to solve long-horizon tasks by generating a plan and then executing it in an environment. However, successful planning requires two distinct capabilities: selecting an appropriate plan for the task and executing it faithfully. Existing planner--executor systems can fail at either stage, while final task success alone cannot distinguish selection from execution failures. We therefore study the Plan Declaration--Execution Gap and introduce Planning-as-Routing, where an LLM declares one of four planning modes: Predefined, Sequential, Hierarchical, or Search, and a deterministic router dispatches the task to the corresponding pattern-specific executor. Across four benchmarks and three LLMs, we find three consistent patterns. First, generic Plan+ReAct often fails to preserve declared planning structure, especially for longer plans: across three benchmarks, only (22)--(45%) of trajectories preserve it

translated_title: LLM智能体真的会执行它们所声明的计划吗？从规划模式声明到模式特定的执行
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）使智能体能够通过先生成计划、再在环境中执行的方式来解决长时程任务。然而，成功的规划需要两种截然不同的能力：为任务选择合适的计划，以及忠实地执行该计划。现有的规划器—执行器系统可能在这两个阶段的任一环节失败，而仅凭最终任务的成功与否无法区分是计划选择失败还是计划执行失败。因此，我们研究了“计划声明—执行鸿沟”（Plan Declaration–Execution Gap），并提出了Planning-as-Routing方法：由LLM声明四种规划模式之一——预定义、顺序、层级或搜索——再由一个确定性路由器将任务分发给对应的模式特定执行器。在四个基准测试和三个LLM上，我们发现了三种一致的模式。首先，通用的Plan+ReAct常常无法保持已声明的规划结构，尤其是在较长的计划中：在三个基准测试上，仅有22%–45%的轨迹能够保持该结构。
tldr: 论文提出Planning-as-Routing框架，让LLM声明四种规划模式（预定义、顺序、层级、搜索）并由确定性路由器分发给模式特定执行器，系统性地揭示了“计划声明—执行鸿沟”——通用Plan+ReAct仅有22%–45%的轨迹能保持其声明的规划结构。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Planning-as-Routing, where an LLM declares one of four planning modes and a deterministic router dispatches tasks to pattern-specific executors, systematically revealing the Plan Declaration–Execution Gap in which generic Plan+ReAct preserves its declared planning structure in only 22–45% of trajectories.
